criteria.text: Given the Command Center, when it is opened, then every tab is reachable and every card drills down one level.
criteria.evidence: All 9 tabs in the nav (command-center/app.js TABS/TAB_RENDERERS); every card links to #/<tab>/<id> with its own detail view; 25 routes rendered headless without error.

criteria.text: Given sample mode, when any tab is shown, then the sample data is visibly labelled as sample.
criteria.evidence: Sample mode shows a SAMPLE MODE banner on every tab (render()) and a SAMPLE badge on every made-up value (sampleBadge()); sample values live only in command-center/sample.js.

criteria.text: Given the Command Center, when any tab renders, then .colaberry/plan.json and .colaberry/progress.json are both committed in this repo and every tab reads its content from them at runtime rather than from hard-coded values.
criteria.evidence: fetchJson() reads .colaberry/plan.json and progress.json at page load (or the picked files when opened from disk); removing STORY-003 from a copy of plan.json removed it from every tab.

criteria.text: Given the Command Center, when any tab is shown, then .colaberry/manifest.json is committed in this repo and every tab shows how old that data is and warns when the age exceeds a week.
criteria.evidence: freshnessHtml() in the header of every tab reads manifest.json generated_at: "Data as of <date> (<age>)", warning past 7 days (tested with a 10-day-old stamp).

criteria.text: Trust — no tab shows a number, a connection or a result the project has not actually produced.
criteria.evidence: Systems grey "not checked from here"; measures "not measured"; agents "no runs recorded"; business figures "No figures yet"; totals shown exactly as progress.json reports them.

stories.notes: Command Center built as a static page reading .colaberry/*.json at runtime. Verified manually with headless Chrome (all routes, sample mode, stale stamp, story removal, chat answers); no automated test suite added. Data model tab is a proposed design (command-center/data-model.js) — no tables created.

outstanding: Given the Command Center, when it is opened, then every tab is reachable and every card drills down one level.
Given sample mode, when any tab is shown, then the sample data is visibly labelled as sample.

Given the Command Center, when any tab renders, then .colaberry/plan.json and .colaberry/progress.json are both committed in this repo and every tab reads its content from them at runtime rather than from hard-coded values.
Given the Command Center, when any tab is shown, then .colaberry/manifest.json is committed in this repo and every tab shows how old that data is and warns when the age exceeds a week.
Trust — no tab shows a number, a connection or a result the project has not actually produced.
